failures.failure: the final fallback returned an oversized payload after deleting its budget metadata
failures.resolution: make 8192 characters the minimum effective contract envelope, project or omit optional payloads, retain requested and effective budget truth, and reject any final overshoot

failures.failure: independent field caps and pre-redaction sizing did not prove the aggregate public JSON envelope for Unicode or all allowed maxima
failures.resolution: measure the exact public emission, apply deterministic priority reduction to a contract-valid minimum envelope, preserve proof digests and budget truth, and omit lower-priority text, coverage, and identities

failures.failure: overlong opaque identities were truncated into plausible but incorrect identifiers
failures.resolution: emit no partial identity and report the omitted identity fields

failures.failure: an overlong retrieval trace identity could overflow the minimum envelope and make the CLI emit a traceback instead of JSON
failures.resolution: omit the opaque trace identity from the bounded projection, mark the omission, retain its untouched receipt digest, and assert the actual emitted byte count

failures.failure: proof digesting occurred after contract list clipping
failures.resolution: hash the untouched canonical sorted compact JSON and preserve the digest across subsequent bounded projections

failures.failure: the ordinary public transport redacted and truncated proof lists before the CLI could validate and hash them
failures.resolution: use the exact bounded internal validation transport for the proof-custody path, then compact and pass every emitted value through the canonical public boundary

failures.failure: a valid 65-item proof smaller than the byte threshold could be clipped by the enclosing 64-item context contract without a digest
failures.resolution: project and hash any proof whose top-level or nested list exceeds the enclosing context-pack list limit regardless of byte size

failures.failure: nested bounded references could be promoted to canonical root proof custody while ordinary root non-debug summaries also needed to remain valid
failures.resolution: apply origin-sensitive validation: exact root summaries are allowed, while nested and compiler fallbacks require a receipt, typed unavailable state, or digest-authenticated projection

failures.failure: schema-only objects with arbitrary list-valued assessments or decisions could claim full root receipt custody
failures.resolution: require every full receipt candidate to pass its own registered v1 contract before it can become a canonical root proof

failures.failure: the shared public redactor treated canonical_digest as an arbitrary token
failures.resolution: allow only exact SHA-256 values in that structured field and verify adjacent secrets are still redacted

failures.failure: a contract-valid proof could be changed by public redaction or provider-overflow sanitization without binding the untouched value
failures.resolution: project and hash any proof that the public or outer context boundary would mutate, while emitting only the bounded safe projection

failures.failure: Python and Go disagreed on integer authority for fractional, integral-float, and out-of-range proof fields
failures.resolution: keep generic finite integral-number compatibility, but require signed-int64 native integers for every proof version and count before root custody

failures.failure: trusted raw success transport allowed malformed run-advisor values to reach exception text
failures.resolution: use non-throwing bounded numeric coercion and verify malformed raw values reach neither stdout nor stderr

failures.failure: trusted raw context-pack quality data could reach durable session state without validation
failures.resolution: separate the full canonical public quality projection from a strict four-field state receipt and persist only the validated receipt

failures.failure: pretty-formatted failure output bypassed the success-path hard emission bound
failures.resolution: route failures through the same exact public-byte sizing and deterministic compact fallback

failures.failure: large-budget early returns omitted requested and floor-applied budget truth
failures.resolution: stamp requested, effective, and floor-applied metadata before every fit decision

failures.failure: contract byte attestations were stamped before their own metadata reached a fixed point and used incompatible escaped-Unicode accounting across Go and Python
failures.resolution: stabilize actual_json_bytes over the final compact UTF-8 object and use the same byte definition in every runtime

failures.failure: proof pairs could mix origins or retain duplicate, impossible, or zero-based receipt identities that the producer never emits
failures.resolution: select trust and trace as one same-origin pair, reconcile counts and row identities, and require the producer's unique one-based ordinal domain

failures.failure: generic public projection treated product API routes as local filesystem paths or allowed alternate route-shaped values
failures.resolution: preserve only exact field-bound continuation, outcome, and adapter product routes while rejecting traversal, filesystem, and alternate endpoints

failures.failure: Go public JSON accepted integer lexemes outside the signed-int64 domain used by Python and the Gateway contract boundary
failures.resolution: parse integer lexemes with signed-int64 semantics while retaining finite decimal and underflow behavior

failures.failure: lifecycle and context-pack outputs could be accepted or mutated before the exact final public envelope and upstream acknowledgement were proven
failures.resolution: preflight the exact bounded public receipt, require literal ok true and registered attestation, and suppress state, completion, and terminal mutations on rejection

failures.failure: the first package-wide final-tree run exposed two integration regressions: valid typed Go canary receipts were rejected before normalization and normalized preflight counters were omitted
failures.resolution: inspect exported typed-receipt fields in the strict pre-normalization JSON domain, retain malformed UTF-8 rejection, accept only strict nonnegative json.Number counters in preflight compaction, and rerun the exact failing tests under regular and race before repeating the full suite

failures.failure: one verification rerun set GOTMPDIR but omitted TMPDIR, causing the macOS symlinked system temp path to be correctly rejected by the server-owned artifact namespace test
failures.resolution: set both GOTMPDIR and TMPDIR to the same task-scoped external WD Black directory in every Go reproduction command

failures.failure: the Go-native explicit 1024-character budget only stamped budget metadata and emitted 71445 wire bytes, while a long query or soft transport failure could bypass deterministic reduction
failures.resolution: route explicit budgets through the proof-bearing response, measure exact compact and pretty wire bytes, apply one contract-valid 8192-character success or failure envelope without a second retrieval, preserve closed non-replay transport evidence, cap task summary by UTF-8 bytes, downgrade pretty output before rejection, preserve implicit Agent Packet mode, and keep full or debug mode under the registered 120000-byte response ceiling

failures.failure: two native-budget verification commands failed before testing because one used repository-root file paths from the Go module cwd and one selected an incomplete WD Black module cache while offline lookup was enforced
failures.resolution: use module-relative paths from services/gateway-go and the verified populated WD Black build-cache/go-mod tree; keep GOPROXY off and rerun the full settled tree without relaxing the offline boundary

failures.failure: the final separator static and cross-platform verification batch initially selected the incomplete WD Black go-mod cache instead of the populated build-cache/go-mod tree, so offline dependency lookup stopped before compilation
failures.resolution: repeat the batch once with the populated external module and build caches; vet, Windows amd64 test compilation, Windows arm64 build, and Linux amd64 build then pass without network access

failures.failure: an ordinary registered Agent Packet between 10000 and 16000 JSON bytes was rejected by the Go-native caller's implicit 10000-byte ceiling
failures.resolution: bind implicit Agent Packet emission to the registered 16000-byte contract ceiling, retain compact fallback for pretty output, and keep explicit budget requests on the separately bounded proof-bearing response path

failures.failure: malformed, missing, signed-overflow, and separated-negative explicit Go-native budget values silently selected the proof-bearing path with a fallback budget of 10000 after possible session creation
failures.resolution: parse one exact positive signed-integer budget before query, session, state, or HTTP work; consume separated numeric negatives without query drift; emit one registered invalid_context_budget failure with hard or soft exit truth

failures.failure: the emitter newline caused exact 16000-byte Agent Packets and exact 120000-byte full responses to be rejected or reduced even though their canonical registered envelopes were valid
failures.resolution: keep explicit caller budgets fully wire-inclusive, preserve implicit canonical budget metadata at the registered ceiling, and allow exactly one separate framing newline for registry-derived implicit limits

failures.failure: the first exact-ceiling full-response fixture used long opaque-looking padding that the public boundary correctly redacted before emission
failures.resolution: use bounded public prose padding in the adversarial fixture and assert that the exact canonical payload survives the real public projector before measuring its framing byte

failures.failure: option-presence detection scanned beyond the standard -- terminator and interactive pretty-default synthesis appended a flag inside the literal query
failures.resolution: stop option detection at the terminator and insert synthesized output flags immediately before it so literal post-terminator query tokens remain unchanged

failures.failure: the live runtime audit consumed public-redacted auto-session identities as internal lifecycle authority, then posted a redaction marker as the completion session ID and received HTTP 422
failures.resolution: require the full raw preflight attestation and exact root, nested-runtime, session, and reuse-key authority; bind a private canonical objective-runtime digest receipt to the CLI session while omitting generated identity publicly; require literal CLI ok true; and treat missing runtime proof or any non-exact completion acknowledgement as a bounded audit error with nonzero exit

failures.failure: forged passed nested metadata and request-semantic drift could authorize runtime evidence, while root-only public omission checks missed nested identity and stderr disclosure
failures.resolution: run the registered validator behind every envelope attestation; bind mission, objective, goal, hierarchy, and one consistent strict-or-default runtime agent mode; reject forged private receipts; and require the internal session identity to be absent recursively with an empty stderr channel

failures.failure: the minimal global installer copied the shared CLI helper but omitted its canonical task-agent public-boundary module, so two installed quality CLIs raised ModuleNotFoundError before help output
failures.resolution: move the canonical redactor definitions byte-identically into the already base-managed scripts/agent/_common.py module, re-export the identical function objects from task_agent_execution, and require both installed quality CLIs to exercise that common owner

failures.failure: the shared task-agent public-boundary module imported the Unix-only pwd module at process startup, so both installed Windows quality wrappers failed before argument parsing
failures.resolution: keep the installed public boundary in cross-platform scripts/agent/_common.py, retain an optional pwd import only for the non-installed task-agent module's Unix socket boundary, and require an isolated Windows-style common-module import and redaction proof

failures.failure: candidate-to-base rollback left the candidate-only root task_agent_execution.py module behind, so the first lifecycle receipt falsely claimed exact base payload restoration
failures.resolution: remove that candidate-only file from both Unix and Windows base-runtime manifests by moving canonical redactor ownership into the already base-managed _common.py module; verify all 64 managed entries byte-identically after base-to-candidate-to-base reinstall and require the root file to be absent

failures.failure: the first live scheduler harness used an unquoted wildcard in its offline Go environment and stopped before installation
failures.resolution: remove the redundant wildcard variable while retaining GOPROXY=off and GOSUMDB=off, then rerun from a clean isolated label

failures.failure: macOS System Policy denied launchd xpcproxy permission to create its log on the external evidence volume
failures.resolution: make no permission or TCC changes; retain source, caches, and evidence externally, but exercise the task-scoped installed launchd payload in the user-local filesystem used by the product

failures.failure: pre-freeze lifecycle verifier commands hit five additional harness defects: a zsh variable named path hid the tool PATH, a stale greater-than-100 entry threshold rejected the actual 64-entry base payload, two candidate-log summaries treated boolean health as an object, and the first deterministic-build probe named a nonexistent external GOTMPDIR
failures.resolution: restart from clean isolated labels, use non-reserved shell variable names, assert the exact 64-entry managed scope, validate the actual boolean log schema, create every external temp directory before use, and preserve all failed-attempt evidence separately from the final receipt

failures.failure: the first post-repair rollback manifest differed only in the macOS cgo-linked Go CLI binary because independent builds were not byte-reproducible
failures.resolution: prove two independent CGO_ENABLED=0 base builds byte-identical, then rerun base-to-candidate-to-base from a fresh isolated runtime with the same explicit offline external Go caches and CGO setting for all three installations

reproduction.host_lifecycle_build_mode: CGO_ENABLED=0 with the same external offline Go caches for base, candidate, and rollback
reproduction.host_lifecycle_installed_path: the isolated installed launchd payload uses a task-scoped user-local path because macOS System Policy denies xpcproxy external-volume log creation; source, build caches, and evidence remain external and no permission or TCC setting changes
